description: Ladies’ Night on Main Street November 19 | 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM In The Village of Stouffville Grab your friends and get ready for a fabulous evening of shopping, dining, entertainment, prizes, and exclusive deals in the Village of Stouffville! Stroll along Main Street from Park Drive to just west of the GO Station and explore special offers, giveaways, and one-of-a-kind experiences from your favourite local shops and restaurants. Enjoy complimentary bites and bubbles at 19 on the Park, and celebrate a night dedicated to community and supporting local businesses. What to Expect ✨ Exclusive in-store promotions and giveaways 🍷 Special dining offers and treats 🛍️ Pop-up shops, demonstrations, and themed displays 🎶 Live entertainment and a festive atmosphere Tickets $15 per person All proceeds support the local food bank, helping families in our community. Ticket holders enjoy access to all Ladies’ Night exclusives throughout Main Street. Plus complimentary prosecco and a sweet treat when supplies last at19 on the Park! This is the perfect opportunity to treat yourself, get a head start on your holiday shopping, and experience the vibrant charm of Stouffville’s historic Main Street. Buy Tickets Here Parking Information There is free street parking (up to three hours) along Main Street. Larger lots are also just a short walk away, including the Booth Drive Parking Lot (Booth Dr, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON L4A 8B6) and 19 on the Park (19 Civic Ave). Presented by the Village of Stouffville.
